decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the candidate-relevant requirement that high-speed mixing remain smooth and not overly aggressive.
The existing same-message MODIFY captures the confirmed motor-speed selection; the splash guard, whisk position, and bowl depth are conditional mitigation options rather than necessary BOM changes.
Potential adjustment of bowl depth or whisk position for splash control does not change the requirement that bowls remain easy to remove and swap.
Whisk positioning is mentioned only as a conditional splash-control mitigation and does not change the selected whisk material, size, compatibility, or shaft attachment.
The conditional possibility of dialing in bowl depth does not establish a new bowl capacity or form requirement.
The source decision concerns splash behavior during higher-speed mixing and does not change the dispensing valve, flow, drive, or operation sequence.
Controlling splashing during high-speed mixing does not alter the existing plumbing and electronics leak-prevention requirements.
The source identifies conditional engineering options for splash control but does not necessarily revise the system-layout or CAD deliverable state.
The high-speed splash-control decision has no effect on the beige and green color scheme.
The high-speed splash-control decision has no effect on machine wording, display name, or placard placement.
The source does not change the DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The source concerns containment during higher-speed bowl mixing and does not change the spout's geometry, construction, appearance, or orientation.
